# Label

`ui.label` · parts: `Label` · elements: `<label>`

## Purpose

Label names a form control.

## Notes

<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:start -->
_No additional notes for Label yet._
<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:end -->

Label renders a native label element.

## Props

| Canonical (templ, Jinja2) | React / Solid | HTML (Svelte, Vue, WC) | Type | Default | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `For` | `htmlFor` | `for` | `string` | — | passthrough attr | id of the labeled control |

Also accepts: `class` (`className` in React), extra attributes (rest props in JS runtimes, `Attrs` in templ/Jinja2, `attrs` in Twig/Latte; caller wins), children.

## Variants

_No variants: the primitive ships no visual classes; style it with token classes via `class`._

## Children

Accepts children (default slot / `children` / `{ children... }` / trusted HTML string in Twig, Latte, Jinja2 — see [runtimes](../runtimes/)). Void tags selected via `tag` render no children.

## ARIA

- No ARIA attributes are rendered by the primitive; rely on native semantics. Pass extra `aria-*` through attrs.

## Classes escape hatch

Compose the part's classes without rendering it (custom root element, no asChild outside React):

| Runtime | Helper |
| --- | --- |
| React / Solid / Vue / Svelte / WC | `labelClasses({ ... })` from `label/label.shared.ts` |
| templ | `label.LabelClasses(label.LabelProps{...})` |
| Twig | `ui8kit_classes('labelClasses', { class: '…' })` |
| Latte | `\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::labelClasses(['class' => '…'])` |
| Jinja2 | `label_classes(p)` |

## Rendered DOM per state

Canonical renderer output (children = `Content`); all 9 runtimes are parity-tested to produce this DOM.

| State | Props | HTML |
| --- | --- | --- |
| defaults | — | `<label>Content</label>` |
| for | `{"For":"email","Class":"text-sm"}` | `<label class="text-sm" for="email">Content</label>` |

## Usage

Fixture `for` (`{"For":"email","Class":"text-sm"}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<label class="text-sm" for="email">Content</label>
```

**React** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/react.md))

```tsx
import { Label } from "./ui/label/label";

<Label className="text-sm" htmlFor="email">Content</Label>
```

**Vue 3** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/vue.md))

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Label from "./ui/label/Label.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Label class="text-sm" for="email">Content</Label>
</template>
```

**Svelte 5** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/svelte.md))

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import Label from "./ui/label/Label.svelte";
</script>

<Label class="text-sm" for="email">Content</Label>
```

**SolidJS** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/solid.md))

```tsx
import { Label } from "./ui/label/label.solid";

<Label class="text-sm" for="email">Content</Label>
```

**Web Components** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/webcomponent.md))

```ts
import { renderLabel } from "./ui/label/label.wc";

document.body.append(renderLabel({ class: "text-sm", for: "email" }, "Content"));
```

**Go templ** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/templ.md))

```templ
import "github.com/ui8kit/codegen/generated/templ/ui/label"

@label.Label(label.LabelProps{For: "email", Class: "text-sm"}) { Content }
```

**Twig** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/twig.md))

```twig
{% include 'label/Label.html.twig' with { htmlFor: 'email', class: 'text-sm', children: 'Content' } only %}
```

**Latte** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/latte.md))

```latte
{include 'label/Label.latte', htmlFor: 'email', class: 'text-sm', children: 'Content'}
```

**Jinja2** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/jinja2.md))

```jinja
{% with p = {'For': 'email', 'Class': 'text-sm'}, children = 'Content' %}{% include 'ui/label/label.html.j2' %}{% endwith %}
```
